df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::D::outgoing.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — Update Service depends on responses from Controller to continue operation
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::D::outgoing.threatDescription: Response blocking: Attacker prevents Update Service from receiving responses from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::E::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker modifies the response from Controller to include elevated roles or permissions, causing Update Service to grant unauthorized access
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::E::outgoing.causeDescription: Update Service trusts response data from Controller without integrity verification, enabling privilege decisions based on forged responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::E::outgoing.threatDescription: Response manipulation for privilege escalation: Attacker manipulates response to gain elevated access in Update Service

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller to Update Service and reads sensitive information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::R::outgoing.attackDescription: Controller claims it never received the data from Update Service, or denies having processed it
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::R::outgoing.causeDescription: No delivery confirmation or cryptographic receipt — Update Service has no proof that Controller received its data
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::R::outgoing.threatDescription: Receiver repudiation: Controller denies receiving or processing the request

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::S::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker sets up a rogue endpoint pretending to be Controller, causing Update Service to send sensitive data to the attacker
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::S::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing endpoint validation before data transmission — Update Service cannot verify the true identity of the receiving endpoint
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::S::outgoing.threatDescription: Receiver spoofing: Attacker impersonates Controller to intercept data from Update Service

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller and modifies data, causing Update Service to process falsified information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Controller — Update Service cannot detect modified responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Update Service

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.attackDescription: Attacker applies excessive electrical input or flooding signals to the interface causing it to fail
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.causeDescription: Interface has no protection against electrical stress or signal flooding — it can be disabled by physical or signal attack
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.threatDescription: Interface denial of service — attacker renders the interface unavailable

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.attackDescription: Attacker exploits the interface to run privileged commands and bypass access controls, or uploads unsigned malicious firmware that disables security controls or installs a persistent backdoor
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.causeDescription: Interface exposes privileged functions without sufficient authentication and accepts firmware updates without signature verification
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.threatDescription: Interface privilege escalation — attacker uses the interface to gain elevated access or inject unauthorized firmware

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.attackDescription: Attacker attaches monitoring equipment to the physical interface and captures transmitted data
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.causeDescription: Physical interface transmits data without encryption — signals are readable with basic test equipment
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.threatDescription: Interface eavesdropping — attacker intercepts data on the physical interface

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.attackDescription: Attacker connects to the physical interface and denies having accessed it because no log record exists
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.causeDescription: No logging of physical interface connections — who connected and when is unknown
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.threatDescription: Interface access repudiation — physical interface access cannot be attributed

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.attackDescription: Attacker connects a rogue device to the interface and impersonates a legitimate system, gaining unauthorized access
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.causeDescription: No hardware authentication on the interface — any device connecting is trusted without verification
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.threatDescription: Interface identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate device on the interface

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.attackDescription: Attacker modifies the interface hardware or firmware to intercept, inject, or block communications
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.causeDescription: Interface lacks tamper detection and physical protection — unauthorized modification is possible without detection
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.threatDescription: Interface tampering — attacker physically or logically tampers with the interface

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.attackDescription: Attacker physically damages the device or cuts power, causing immediate loss of availability
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.causeDescription: No physical protection or anchoring — device can be damaged, unplugged, or destroyed
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.threatDescription: Physical destruction or power disruption — device rendered unavailable by physical attack

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.attackDescription: Attacker opens the physical boundary and connects to internal debug interface, bypassing all software authentication
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.causeDescription: Physical access to device interior grants debug/hardware access — logical security can be bypassed
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.threatDescription: Physical privilege escalation — attacker gains elevated system access via physical boundary breach

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.attackDescription: Attacker measures power consumption or EM emissions and extracts cryptographic keys
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.causeDescription: Physical boundary provides no electromagnetic shielding — internal operations are observable
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.threatDescription: Side-channel observation — sensitive data extracted via physical measurements

el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.attackDescription: Attacker opens the enclosure without triggering any alarm, gaining access to internal components
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.causeDescription: No tamper detection mechanism — unauthorized opening is undetected
el::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.threatDescription: Physical boundary tampering — unauthorized physical access to boundary interior
